name: Shortest
description: End-to-end testing framework where tests are plain-English sentences executed in a browser by a Claude-powered agent.
whatItDoes: Lets developers write a test as a description of user behaviour and have an agent perform and judge it. It fits web teams who want coverage without maintaining selector-based scripts.
howItWorks: An init command sets the project up. The runner starts a Playwright browser, gives the model the test description and lets it operate the page with computer-use style actions before reporting pass or fail. Callbacks allow extra assertions, and an optional secret supports GitHub two-factor logins.

requirements.name: GITHUB_TOTP_SECRET
requirements.description: For tests that sign in with GitHub 2FA
